concept: binary search over a sorted array
mapping: A benchtop comparator holds an array of eight stepped gauge blocks; two sliding cursor jaws frame the active search interval while an index carriage drops a dial probe onto the midpoint block, pivoting brass shutter flaps down over the eliminated half until the matching block is pinned.
parts: Cast iron base plate, four knurled leveling feet with rubber isolator pads, four corner cap screws, inset oil groove, left and right cast end uprights, two ground steel guide rails, milled gauge bed with eight transverse block pockets, eight stepped brass gauge blocks with engraved numerals, eight pivoting exclusion shutter flaps with hinge pins, left boundary cursor jaw, right boundary cursor jaw, center probe carriage with dual sleeve bushings, vertical dial indicator housing with knurled bezel, indicator spindle plunger, contact feeler foot, and right-hand lead screw thumbwheel.
